thread:
harper: quick catch from accessibility pass on the model catalog compare. pinning a version reorders rows and keyboard focus jumps out of the compare panel. repro steps below. tagging @kim + @leo. :wave:

leo: steps?

harper: Catalog -> apply filter -> select 2 models -> Compare -> click Pin on left row. active element is lost; sometimes SR reads the top nav. Happens on Chrome + VoiceOver and NVDA.

anya: sounds like we're moving the DOM node to the pinned group. that will kill `document.activeElement`. are we actually doing `table.prepend(row)` on toggle?

harper: yes. simplified snippet: 

```
if (model.pinned) {
  pinnedGroup.prepend(row)
}
```

leo: we should avoid reparenting interactive nodes. design preference is to keep DOM stable and visually anchor pinned rows. two approaches: (A) CSS sticky/transform to visually lift, or (B) render a visual-only clone anchored at top and keep original row inert.

kim: from design: prefer stable DOM. clone approach okay only if clone is completely inert: `aria-hidden="true"` and `tabindex="-1"`. keyboard focus should never land on the clone.

anya: agree. clone must not create duplicate tabbable elements. better: `position: sticky` on the pinned row container so we don't duplicate nodes. example CSS: 

```
.pinned-row { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 3; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
```

harper: sticky solves focus but we also need to ensure SRs don't double-announce changes. we currently have an `aria-live` region that publishes the full compare diff on any update, so toggling pin produces a noisy double announcement.

leo: fix: consolidate announcements. On pin toggle only emit one polite message like `Pinned v1.2.3`. Use `role=status` and clear it after a short timeout. avoid re-announcing the whole table.

kim: microcopy: button should be short -> `Pin`. tooltip copy -> `Pinned — keeps this version visible in compare views`. toast copy -> `Pinned v1.2.3. Undo`. keep toast `aria-live="polite"` and include accessible undo button.

anya: tooltip portal issue: performance badge tooltip gets clipped when pinned anchor is near panel edge. solution: mount tooltips to `document.body` via portal or ensure container has `overflow: visible`. also include percentile numbers in tooltip ("p50 120ms · p95 420ms") and set `aria-label` on the badge: `aria-label="Latency p95 420ms"`.

harper: extra a11y nit: keyboard toggle should announce state change inline like `role="status"` text that SRs pick up: "Pinned v1.2.3". don't rely on transient toasts alone.

leo: engineering plan: implement sticky pinned UI for compare panel + global tooltip portal + focused `role/status` for pin toggles. if sticky causes layout issues, fallback to clone approach but ensure clone inertness and delegate pointer events to original row.

kim: design decision: canonical interaction should remain on the original row (not the clone). clones are purely visual anchors. that preserves permalinks and tab order.

harper: QA items: run keyboard-only flow, NVDA, VoiceOver, and test filter-presets retention (pin should not reset filter chips). also check that keyboard shortcuts (g then c) maintain focus in the compare panel after pin.

design-bot: added copy snippet to `catalog/copy/pins.md` -> "Pin (button) — Pin this model version to keep it visible in comparison views. Tooltip: 'Pinned — keeps this version visible in compare views'. Toast: 'Pinned vX.Y.Z — Undo'"

leo: i'll scope state updates to the compare slice to avoid top-level re-renders that reset filter chip `aria-pressed`. will open PR and tag @harper for a11y QA.

kim: one last UX tweak: consider a small visual divider between pinned anchor and rest of rows so users understand grouping. ensure divider has semantic aria separation only visually — don't add extra interactive elements.

harper: noted. attaching a short screen recording and a quick CSS patch for tooltip portal in the PR. leaving this thread open for followups. :thumbsup:
